title: Collectable Cup Set
description: Collectable Cup Set — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Okon

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go into Upper MutantMania and clobber anyone that may have acquired a collectable cup. Once you have a complete set, return it to Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Okon

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go into Upper MutantMania and clobber anyone that may have acquired a collectable cup. Once you have a complete set, return it to Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Thankth again for breaking up that NaijeerianConsular419 thcam. I heard that a delivery of collectable MutantMania cupth wath thtolen from ectoBay. I bet thothe mean guyth in the MutantMania dungeon got 'em all.

I already have a thet of thothe cupth from when they firtht came out, but do you think you could try to find thome of the mithing cupth? I'd love a whole 'nother thet!

Turn-in:

Wowie, thatth amathing!!

If thethe cupth weren't tho cool I would give them as birthday gift'th.

Objectives:

  • Jumping Josiah's cup ×1
  • Dangerous Dmitri's cup ×1
  • Ravishing Reginald's cup ×1
  • Sandy Shores's cup ×1
  • Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous's cup ×1

Level range: 83–93
